changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Resource]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table [dbo].[Resource]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Username] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Password] [nvarchar](50) MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()') NOT NULL, [LastName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [FirstName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Email] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [APIPublicKey] [varchar](25) CONSTRAINT [DF_Resource_APIPublicKey] DEFAULT ([dbo].[GenerateAPIKeyWrapper](25)) NOT NULL, [APIPrivateKey] [varchar](50) CONSTRAINT [DF_Resource_APIPrivateKey] DEFAULT ([dbo].[GenerateAPIKeyWrapper](50)) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Resource_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Resource_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, constraint [PK_Resource] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Resource]') AND name = N'IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resource_APIPublicKey_APIPrivateKey] ON [dbo].[Resource] ( [APIPublicKey] ASC, [APIPrivateKey] ASC ) end
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Resource]') AND name = N'IX_Resource_UID') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resource_UID] ON [dbo].[Resource] ( [uid] ASC ) end
